open_points.subject: FlowActivation creation trigger (M18 vs State 0 K-08/Primary actions)
open_points.text: K-08: "A read-only flow is activated by the kernel once proven"; Primary actions: "activate a flow | agent or owner asks; the kernel activates a proven read-only version at once"; M18 source: "The kernel, after proof and, for effectful versions, the owner."
open_points.question: When exactly is a FlowActivation created for a proven read-only flow: automatically at compose/prove time, or only when someone calls the activate action?
options: Automatic activation immediately after a successful proof of a read-only version
Activation only via the explicit activate action (kernel just auto-approves that request for read-only)
open_points.default_guess: Activation only via explicit activate action, because State 0 keeps a separate "activate a flow" product action.

open_points.subject: ManifestOperation identity (M10)
open_points.text: M10 candidate fields include "base_url" and "required_headers, instance_class" from the selected instance, while identity says: "Substitution: equal readings of the same record digest are the same. Continuity: none; a changed record is another reading."
open_points.question: Do installation-selected instance facts (base_url/required_headers/instance_class) participate in ManifestOperation identity, or is identity only by operation record_digest?
options: Identity includes all meaning fields, including selected-instance facts
Identity is only the operation capability record digest; instance facts are runtime context
open_points.default_guess: Identity includes selected-instance facts, since they are listed as meaning fields and change invocation target/facts.

open_points.subject: StandingGrant applicability domain (M25 / K-08 / primary action)
open_points.text: Primary action: "grant a standing approval for a node of a flow's active version"; K-08: "each `state-transition`, `external-effect` and `destructive` node stops ... unless ... standing approval ... `destructive` never takes a grant"; M25 only states "A grant never covers a `destructive` node."
open_points.question: Which nodes are eligible for StandingGrant creation: only operation nodes that can require per-run approval, or any non-destructive node (including read/draft-write/function nodes)?
options: Only operation nodes of class state-transition or external-effect
open_points.default_guess: Only operation nodes that otherwise stop for owner approval (state-transition/external-effect).
